fields.ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)
must_have_properties: Two mandatory dedicated pins: SWCLK (host-driven) and SWDIO (bidirectional).
Every transaction is exactly 46 bits: Request + Turnaround + ACK + Data + Parity + Turnaround.
Request packet: Start=1, Stop=0, Park=1; Parity even over APnDP+RnW+A[2:3].
ACK encoding: OK=001, WAIT=010, FAULT=100 (one-hot only).
Data: 32 bits LSB first + 33rd parity bit (even parity).
DPIDR register at A[3:2]=0x0 read; bit 0 hard-wired to 1 (RAO).
ABORT register at A[3:2]=0x0 write; supports DAPABORT + STKCMPCLR + STKERRCLR + WDERRCLR + ORUNERRCLR.
SELECT register at A[3:2]=0x8 write; APSEL + APBANKSEL + DPBANKSEL fields.
Up to 256 APs addressable via SELECT.APSEL.
MEM-AP register catalog: CSW, TAR, DRW, CFG, BASE, IDR at minimum.
Line reset = ≥ 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH.
Post-reset host first transaction is IDCODE/DPIDR read.
Posted reads: data of read N returned with ACK of read N+1; final via DP.RDBUFF.
must_have_if_device_identification_regis: Device Identification Register is exactly 32 bits.
Bit 0 of Device ID is hard-wired to 1.
must_not_have_properties: Request with Start=0, Stop=1, or Park=0.
Data parity bit not equal to even parity of the 32 data bits.
SWD pins shared with functional pins.
Posted reads where data of read N is returned with ACK of read N.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: ABORT clear bits don't actually clear sticky bits.
AP returns data at ACK of read N instead of N+1.
STICKYERR not set on system-bus DECERR/SLVERR.
Target releases SWDIO too early/late vs host.

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: After line reset or power-on: SW-DP returns to Idle; DP.SELECT cleared (APSEL=APBANKSEL=DPBANKSEL=0); CTRL/STAT cleared; posted-read queue drained. First host transaction must be IDCODE/DPIDR read.
must_have_if_swj_dp_present: 16-bit JTAG-to-SWD selection sequence 0xE79E (LSB first) shall be recognized.
16-bit SWD-to-JTAG selection sequence 0xE73C (LSB first) shall be recognized.
Both selection sequences shall be preceded and followed by ≥ 50 cycles TMS/SWDIO=HIGH.
must_have_if_adiv5_1_plus: TARGETID register at DP bank 2; bit 0 = 1 (RAO).
must_have_if_adiv5_2_multidrop: TARGETSEL transaction routes subsequent transactions only to matching target.
Non-addressed targets shall ignore the bus after TARGETSEL mismatch.
